name: Evercore Inc.
summary: Evercore Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an independent investment banking firm in the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. The company operates through two segments, Investment Banking & Equities, and Investment Management. The Investment Banking & Equities segment offers strategic advisory services, such as mergers, and acquisitions, strategic, defense, and shareholder advisory, special committee assignments, and real estate strategic advisory; private capital advisory and fundraising, market risk management and hedging, private capital markets and debt advisory, liability management and restructuring, and equity capital markets execution and advisory …
